newsitem.title: USA: Isis says CMV retinitis drug effective.
newsitem.headline: Isis says CMV retinitis drug effective.

text.p: Isis Pharmaceuticals said on Thursday that its antisense drug for CMV retinitis was effective in stopping the progression of the disease in some cases.

The company was to present data at the Association for Vision Research and Ophthalmology meeting in Ft. Lauderdale, Fla., showing that fomivirsen (ISIS 2922) was effective among patients whose disease had progressed with other CMV retinitis therapies, including cidofovir, and who had no other viable treatment options.

Data also showed that patients receiving repeated intravitreal fomivirsen injections experienced a lower retinal detachment rate than what would be expected in a patient population with advanced CMV retinitis, the company said.
